name: people-picker
title: People Picker
description: The one picker for people and teams — a field (single or multiple), a popover body for a host trigger, or a dropdown submenu — with avatar rows, "(you)", team sizes, skeleton loading, footer actions and active people only.

meta.whenToUse: Choose a person (assignee, owner, manager) or several people and teams (members of a team or space, a share invite), or filter by person — every people picker.
meta.whenNotToUse: Type free-form tokens such as emails (ChipInput), or pick non-person records (SearchableSelect).
